title: Archidocs workspace.yaml

teams.description: The Teams of the Workspace, keyed by id. Every `owner` in every Project names one of these ids.

description.description: A short description of the Team.

links.description: Links to pages about the Team.

additionalProperties.description: A Team: a group that can own Elements and Deployment Targets. Its key is the Team's id.

environments.description: The Environments of the Workspace, keyed by id. Every Deployment in every Project names one of these ids.

name.description: The Environment's display name, such as `Production`.

description.description: A short description of the Environment.

additionalProperties.description: An Environment: a named stage that Services run in, such as prod or staging. Its key is the Environment's id.

description: `workspace.yaml`: the Teams and Environments that every Project in the Workspace shares.

label.description: The text of the link, such as `Runbook`.

url.description: The page the link opens. A full URL, such as `https://wiki.example.com/runbooks/web`.

Link.title: Link
Link.description: A link to a page about the thing it is declared on, such as a runbook or a dashboard.
